svg.title: StockResearchAgents system context and authority boundaries
svg.desc: A caller runtime owns models, credentials, retrieval, and scheduling. The separate research-data MCP returns a direct SourceBatch by default and an optional SourcePortfolioReceipt only when a portfolio collector is explicitly configured. CLI, Python, and coordination MCP adapters use StockResearchApplication for completed reads, responses, cohort evaluation, and diagnostics, while dedicated application command functions own plan, import, and lifecycle mutations. ApplicationRuntime composes the coordinator and durable stores from StateLayout, while domain-owned deterministic validation and CompletedPublicationSaga gate completed publication.
